scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && vite build && node scripts/assert-production-fixtures.mjs
scripts.generate:openapi: uv run launchplane service export-openapi --output generated/openapi-canonical.json && node scripts/build-openapi-ui-schema.mjs && node scripts/generate-openapi-types.mjs && pnpm generate:agent-contract
scripts.test:browser: pnpm check:browser-timing && node scripts/prepare-browser-smoke.mjs && node --test tests/browser-support/*.test.mjs && node scripts/run-browser-smoke.mjs
scripts.validate: pnpm check:browser-timing && pnpm test && pnpm check:openapi-drift && pnpm build
